name: Hitozuma Sentai Aisaiger Flash
original_name: 人妻戦隊アイサイガーFLASH
source:
Miku, Naotaro's wife, gets pregnant. But eight months later, her belly suddenly gets shrunk. When she is at a loss what to do, a monster appears in front of her. "I'm the one who erased your baby. I'm sorry, but there was no other way to achieve our purpose." "What!? No other way? Do you mean you erased my baby only for that?" A big battle between Aisaiger and monsters begins....

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
直太郎的妻子未来怀孕了。然而八个月后，她的肚子却突然恢复平坦。她正不知所措时，一只怪物出现在面前。“是我抹去了你的孩子。很抱歉，但为了实现我们的目的，别无他法。”“什么！？别无他法？你仅仅为了那个目的，就抹去了我的孩子？”爱妻战队与怪物之间的大战就此开始…

[摘自ErogeShop]
